title: SORTDEMO.BAS
summary: A three-minute capture of SORTDEMO.BAS, the sorting visualization that shipped with QBasic. It animates insertion, bubble, heap, exchange, shell and quick sort with chiptune-like sound.
why: HN fondly recalls it as the ideal visual demonstration of sorting algorithms and as the thing that got some people into programming.

quote.text: this is still my ideal for demonstrating different sorts visually
